newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stock mkts switch to longer summer trade hrs.
newsitem.headline: Chile stock mkts switch to longer summer trade hrs.

text.p: Chile's commercial and electronic stock exchanges said they will extend their trading day by one hour from Monday with both markets closing at 1730 local time/2130 GMT.
The exchanges have extended their hours for the past two years for the Southern Hemisphere summer. The hours go back to normal at the end of the season.
Chile will move its clocks forward one hour midnight Saturday.
The bolsas will open at the usual 0930 local time/1330 GMT.
